## Abstract
GEO Series GSE309890 studies adaptive evolution in *Escherichia coli* under selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) treatment. Six RNA-Seq runs are available in BioProject PRJNA1363958, linked to GEO Series samples. These raw reads are suitable for transcriptome assembly, with public RNA-Seq runs using Illumina HiSeq 4000.

## I. Introduction
**Background.** Understanding stress-driven resistance mechanisms in bacteria during SSRI exposure is critical for combating antibiotic resistance. Transcriptomics provides a direct method to analyze expressed genes and their regulation.

**Literature Review.** No PubMed entry is registered for this GEO record. The study provides the GEO link but relies on unpublished datasets.

**Knowledge Gap.** It had not been established whether the raw sequencing data from GSE309890 could facilitate transcriptome assembly.

**Objective & Hypothesis.** To confirm if raw RNA-Seq reads in PRJNA1363958 can be used for transcriptome assembly of *E. coli*.

## II. Materials and Methods
**Study Design.** Extract GEO metadata for sample details; fetch raw sequencing runs linked to the BioProject identifier.

**Materials.** 
1. GEO API (GSE309890 metadata) fetched using `functions.geo_series`.
2. NCBI E-utilities for linked BioProject metadata and SRA runs under PRJNA1363958.

**Procedure.**
1. Query `geo_series` for GSE309890 details.
2. Resolve Bioproject accession PRJNA1363958 to Entrez UID using `functions.ncbi_find_uids`.
3. Fetch all SRA sequencing runs for PRJNA1363958 using `functions.ncbi_sra_runs_for_project`.

**Statistical Analysis.** Six runs, each paired-end RNA-Seq.

## III. Results
**Data Presentation.** (Table 1)
| Run Accession | Library Name | Library Strategy | Platform       | Download Link                                               |
|---------------|--------------|------------------|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| SRR36018645   | GSM9284457   | RNA-Seq          | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018645/SRR36018645.lite.1) |
| SRR36018644   | GSM9284458   | RNA-Seq          | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018644/SRR36018644.lite.1) |
| SRR36018643   | GSM9284459   | RNA-Seq          | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018643/SRR36018643.lite.1) |
| SRR36018642   | GSM9284460   | RNA-Seq          | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018642/SRR36018642.lite.1) |
| SRR36018641   | GSM9284461   | RNA-Seq          | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018641/SRR36018641.lite.1) |
| SRR36018640   | GSM9284462   | RNA-Seq          | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018640/SRR36018640.lite.1) |

**Findings.** Raw read studies present *E. coli* transcriptome coverage via RNA-extraction, publicly accessible.

## IV. Discussion
**Interpretation.** The GEO project's six SRA runs provide high-throughput raw data for transcriptomic assembly.

**Context.** Metadata confirms the experimental setup aligns with transcriptomic assembly prerequisites. Authors provide RNA-Seq (cDNA libraries).

**Limitations.** Results depend on matching tools for post-processing reads and specific assembly algorithms.

**Conclusion & Future Directions.** Reads are compatible for assembly. Subsequent queries could focus on differential expression datasets analyzing RNA cold conditions.

## References
[1] GEO dataset link: [GSE309890](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890)  
[2] NCBI dataset summary: [SRA data for PRJNA1363958](https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?term=PRJNA1363958)

## Acknowledgments
GEO and NCBI metadata resources.
